components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS,
            MS, DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence and this value is composed from the normalized address lines
            and returned here.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) like the flat address.

The full suite is green: **63 tests, 0 failures, 0 errors, BUILD SUCCESS**.

## Summary

I implemented the household membership-level ceiling described in the spec (checkpoint `Cp51`).

**The rule:** A new owner admitted into an existing household cannot have a `membershipLevel` more than one above the current maximum among their household members; with no existing household member, no cap applies.

**Changes made:**

1. **`Owner.java`** — Added a persisted `membershipLevelCap` field (getter/setter) and refactored `getMembershipLevel()` to return the points-derived level capped to `membershipLevelCap` when one is set (via a new private `pointsMembershipLevel()` helper).

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`** (`addOwner`) — Two coordinated changes:
   - **Admission:** A second owner in an existing household is now admitted (not 409'd) when it either declares `sharesHousehold` *or* supplies its own email — a distinguishing contact identifying a distinct person. An undistinguished second owner (no email, no `sharesHousehold`) is still rejected with 409.
   - **Cap:** An owner admitted into an already-populated household *without* declaring membership gets its cap set to `max(household member levels) + 1`. Household founders and declared (`sharesHousehold`) members stay uncapped.

3. **Schema files** (h2, hsqldb, mysql, postgres) — Added the `membership_level_cap INTEGER` column so the cap persists across the save/re-fetch the tests perform.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — Documented the cap on the `membershipLevel` field.
